_comment: Power module messages — Controller <-> Gateway <-> Agent
_safety_note: Lock executes immediately. Restart / Shutdown / Sleep require a 10-second countdown + user confirmation on the Controller side before the command is sent.

power_lock._desc: Lock the agent machine immediately (no countdown needed)

power_restart._desc: Restart the agent machine (sent only after Controller 10s countdown completes)

power_shutdown._desc: Shut down the agent machine (sent only after Controller 10s countdown completes)

power_sleep._desc: Put the agent machine to sleep (sent only after Controller 10s countdown completes)

power_result._desc: Agent confirms whether the power action was executed

power_result_cancelled._desc: Used when Controller cancels the countdown before sending — Gateway/Agent may never see this; shown here for reference.
